title: A road course out in the cotton
text: Buttonwillow has a racetrack named after it, Buttonwillow Raceway Park, {distance} from here. It opened in 1995, and it is owned and run by the California Sports Car Club. The layout drivers use most is three miles long with 23 turns. Since 2004 it has held the Super Lap Battle, a time attack event where cars run against the clock.
